company.name: Predictiv
company.shortDescription: Predictiv Data transforms your strategy with unified buyer intent insights, helping you connect with the right prospects at the right time.
company.description: Accelerate customer acquisition by leveraging AI and human insights to identify and prioritize high-intent leads. Through strategic partnerships with industry leaders Bombora and LeadSift, we enrich our first-party intent insights to ensure your GTM efforts are precisely targeted and highly efficient, maximizing your ROI. Predictiv helps B2B teams turn buyer intent into real pipeline by activating the right accounts, channels, and buying committees at the right time. Powered by unified opportunity signals and first-party execution, we help you turn unseen potential into measurable growth through content syndication, email marketing, programmatic advertising, and appointment setting.

productsAndServices.description: A four-step AI-driven process that unifies multiple data signals to identify, prioritize, and engage high-value B2B revenue opportunities across the full buying committee.
productsAndServices.name: Revenue Activation Framework

productsAndServices.description: A scoring system that combines first-party and third-party intent data from three sources to provide a unified, ranked signal of buyer readiness for sales and marketing teams.
productsAndServices.name: 3x Intent Model

productsAndServices.description: A data integration service that consolidates firmographic, technographic, demographic, and behavioral intent data into a single actionable view for B2B revenue teams.
productsAndServices.name: Unified Revenue Opportunity Signals

productsAndServices.description: In-house execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns including content syndication, email marketing, programmatic display, and appointment setting to engage entire buyer committees.
productsAndServices.name: Full-Funnel Campaign Execution

productsAndServices.description: Provision of clean, compliant B2B contact and company data enriched with intent and technographic insights to support sales and marketing strategies.
productsAndServices.name: B2B Buyer Data and Insights

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,642,235 to $15,642,235, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Bombora, 6sense, Demandbase.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
